Details: ModularFormView[y] gives a DisplayDocument of a modular form: representation and basis, weight, the definition (closed expression, MLDE or derivative recipe, or finite jet), the expression, the stored q-expansion or "not computed", the normalization and the evidence.

Read-only: no expansion, coefficient solve, validation or GAP; render with ToNotebook, ToLaTeX or ExportDisplay. Options: FormLabels, IrrepLabels, ExpressionMode, MaxQTerms, FactorQSeries and the presentation options.
ModularFormView.Example: Module[{g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, one, y}, AssignModularGenerators[g, GroupWord["t^-1.s.t"], GroupWord["s"], StoreGAPState -> False]; d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; one = g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]; y = First[ConstructModularForms[g, d]]; ModularFormGetCoeff[y, WorkingPrecision -> 30]; DisplayData[ModularFormView[y]]["Weight"]]

Details: ModularFormTable[{y1, y2, ...}] tabulates modular forms in the given order with their labels, irreps, weights, expressions, stored expansions and status.
Every element is validated; forms over different groups or assignments get their own section titles. Options: as ModularFormView plus IncludeWeight.
ModularFormTable.Example: Module[{g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, one, y}, AssignModularGenerators[g, GroupWord["t^-1.s.t"], GroupWord["s"], StoreGAPState -> False]; d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; one = g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]; y = First[ConstructModularForms[g, d]]; ModularFormGetCoeff[y, WorkingPrecision -> 30]; Length[DisplayData[ModularFormTable[{y, y}, IncludeWeight -> False]]["Rows"]]]

Details: QExpansionView[y] or QExpansionView[qexp] gives a DisplayDocument of a stored or supplied q-expansion with exact rational powers, hidden-term markers and the stored cutoff.
A missing expansion shows "not computed" (ModularFormQExp stores one); an expansion that does not belong to the form's record fails StaleExpansion.
QExpansionView.Example: Module[{g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, one, y}, AssignModularGenerators[g, GroupWord["t^-1.s.t"], GroupWord["s"], StoreGAPState -> False]; d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; one = g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]; y = First[ConstructModularForms[g, d]]; ModularFormGetCoeff[y, WorkingPrecision -> 30]; DisplayData[QExpansionView[y]]["Status"]]

Details: ModularDimensionView[table] gives a DisplayDocument of a ModularDimensionTable result, keeping known zero, unknown (Missing), failed and not-requested cells distinct.
It computes nothing. Options: IrrepLabels and the presentation options.
ModularDimensionView.Example: Module[{g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, one, y}, AssignModularGenerators[g, GroupWord["t^-1.s.t"], GroupWord["s"], StoreGAPState -> False]; d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; one = g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]; y = First[ConstructModularForms[g, d]]; ModularFormGetCoeff[y, WorkingPrecision -> 30]; DisplayData[ModularDimensionView[ModularDimensionTable[g, All, {0, 2}]]]["Weights"]]

Details: FormSlotTable[m] gives a DisplayDocument of the form slots of a modular model: labels, irreps, weights, copies, space dimensions, whether a term uses them and their frozen bindings.
Bindings are read from the model's frozen records, never from live forms. Options: FormSlotLabels, IrrepLabels and the presentation options.
FormSlotTable.Example: Module[{g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, one, y}, AssignModularGenerators[g, GroupWord["t^-1.s.t"], GroupWord["s"], StoreGAPState -> False]; d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; one = g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]; y = First[ConstructModularForms[g, d]]; ModularFormGetCoeff[y, WorkingPrecision -> 30]; Length[DisplayData[FormSlotTable[Module[{c = RepresentationContext[g], df, rf, m0}, df = CreateField[c, d, "D"]; rf = CreateField[c, one, "R"]; m0 = CreateModularModel[c, {df, rf}, FieldWeights -> <|df["ID"] -> 1, rf["ID"] -> 1|>]; AddModelTerm[m0, CoupleContractions[ModularContractions[m0, {df, rf}]]]]]]["Slots"]]]

Details: SaveModularFormData[<|name -> y, ...|>, file] or SaveModularFormData[y, file] saves modular forms with their group as a versioned JSON archive (records, definitions, coefficients and anchor frames, stored expansions, evidence) and returns the path.
Forms of one group state per archive; an existing file needs Overwrite -> True; no code or GAP state is saved and nothing is computed.
SaveModularFormData.Example: Module[{g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, one, y}, AssignModularGenerators[g, GroupWord["t^-1.s.t"], GroupWord["s"], StoreGAPState -> False]; d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; one = g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]; y = First[ConstructModularForms[g, d]]; ModularFormGetCoeff[y, WorkingPrecision -> 30]; FileExistsQ[SaveModularFormData[y, FileNameJoin[{$TemporaryDirectory, "vvmf-doc-forms-" <> CreateUUID[] <> ".json"}]]]]

Details: ImportModularFormData[file] imports a modular form archive as fresh independent ModularForm handles (names of one archived form share one handle) at revision 1.

Every record is rebound to the admitted group, checked against its stored expansion and published all at once; archived proof claims are kept only for a trusted export. Options: ValidationGroup and the GAP job options.
ImportModularFormData.Example: Module[{g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, one, y}, AssignModularGenerators[g, GroupWord["t^-1.s.t"], GroupWord["s"], StoreGAPState -> False]; d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; one = g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]; y = First[ConstructModularForms[g, d]]; ModularFormGetCoeff[y, WorkingPrecision -> 30]; ModularFormRep[ImportModularFormData[SaveModularFormData[y, FileNameJoin[{$TemporaryDirectory, "vvmf-doc-forms-" <> CreateUUID[] <> ".json"}]]]["Form"]] === ModularFormRep[y]]
